name: The Usurper's Claim
about: A great lord finds a better claim to the throne than yours, wins another house to it in secret, and marches on Kingsmere. Each act comes to your court; gold buys time, not an end.
title: The Claim of {pretender.house}
fade: {thread} is spoken of less each season, and then not at all.

beats.speaker: witness
text: In {seat}, {pretender} has found letters in the old archive: the Conqueror's line ran through {pretender.house}, not yours. The whispers reach Kingsmere before the snow.
A boy in {seat} is said to be the last son of the old kings, raised in secret, and {pretender} keeps him close. The whispers reach Kingsmere before the snow.
{pretender} tells any lord who will listen that the crown was given to the wrong brother three generations ago, and that {pretender.he} means to set it right.

court.text: {witness} of {witness.house}: "Your Grace, {pretender} speaks of a better claim to your throne, and some lords are listening. What would you have me tell them?"

options.label: Summon {pretender} to Kingsmere to answer for it
options.result: {pretender} is summoned to Kingsmere. {pretender.He} comes, bows low, and says nothing of claims. The whispers pause.

options.label: Buy {pretender}'s silence (200 gold)
options.hint: {pretender.houseName} +10 · it buys time, not an end
options.result: Gold goes north to {seat}. For a season, {pretender} speaks only of the harvest.

options.label: Let them talk, and watch who listens
options.result: The King lets the rumour run. In every hall, someone is counting who nods.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {seat} is quiet, and its lord spends the King's gold on new walls and more men.

beats.speaker: pretender
text: A rider with {pretender.house}'s seal is taken on the road to {backer.seat}. The letter he carries promises {backer.house} a duchy when {pretender} is crowned.
{pretender} and {backer} meet at a hunting lodge between their lands. By morning, they have sworn to each other on the old claim.

court.text: {witness} lays a broken seal before the throne: "{pretender} and {backer} have sworn to each other, Your Grace. Strike now, or win one of them back."

options.label: Seize {pretender}'s envoys and read the letters to the court
options.result: The letters are read aloud in the great hall. {backer} goes white; {pretender} goes home and sharpens swords.

options.label: Win {backer} back to the crown (300 gold)
options.result: {backer} takes the King's gold and the King's hand, and sends {pretender}'s letters back unopened.

options.label: Let them plot; the throne is not won with letters
options.result: The King lets them plot. In {seat} the smiths work through the night.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: Alone, and still warm to the crown, {pretender} burns the old letters in the hall at {seat}. The claim is never spoken of again.

memory.pretender: I had a claim to the throne, and I let it go.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {pretender} declares for the throne in the square at {seat}. The banners of {pretender.house} are raised, and every house must choose.

court.text: {witness}: "It is open war, Your Grace. {pretender} has declared. How does the crown answer?"

options.label: Name {pretender} a traitor and an outlaw
options.hint: {pretender.houseName} −40 · the realm must choose · call the banners after
options.result: Heralds ride to every town: {pretender} is outlawed, and whoever shelters {pretender.him} is a traitor too.

options.label: Offer {pretender} a seat on the council (500 gold)
options.hint: {pretender.houseName} +25 · a chance at peace, a sign of weakness
options.result: The King offers {pretender} a seat at his right hand. The whole realm waits to see if {pretender.he} takes it.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {pretender} rides to Kingsmere under a white banner and kneels. The claim is set aside; the seat on the council is not.

memory.pretender: I knelt to the King, and he gave me a seat at his side.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {pretender}'s host marches on Kingsmere. If the walls fall, so does the crown.

beats.speaker: witness
beats.text: {pretender}'s host is broken before Kingsmere. The claim dies in the mud, and the houses that stood by the crown remember that they did.

memory.pretender: My claim was broken before the walls of Kingsmere.

beats.text: With {pretender} in the grave, the claim has no one to carry it. {thread} is buried with {pretender.him}.
